title: UNI receives approval for Chuck and Barbara Grassley Center focused on public engagement, civic learning and archival stewardship
summary_en: The new center will honor the legacy of Chuck and Barbara Grassley while expanding opportunities for civic learning, scholarship and public engagement
title_cn: UNI receives approval for Chuck and Barbara Grassley Center focused on public engagement, civic learning and archival stewardship

title: UNI to formally celebrate 150th anniversary Friday
summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa will formally celebrate its 150th anniversary with a commemorative program at 2 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18, in the Maucker Union Ballrooms.
title_cn: UNI to formally celebrate 150th anniversary Friday
